## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Baseline strategy uses qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account would realize ~14% of headline P&L due to position sizing constraints.
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 BS-synthetic backtest used all available SPY/VIX bars (approx 16 months) with no walk-forward split; high overfit risk as it optimizes on entire period.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS -- walk-forward OOS validation not yet executed.
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS -- realistic OPRA fill simulation not yet executed.
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day in BS-synthetic: max drawdown $4,701.52; blow-up scenario if volatility regime shifts causing repeated stops; concentration risk: top 5 days = 999% of P&L (indicating extreme reliance on few days).
6. **Concentration:** In BS-synthetic, top5_pct=999.0 (top 5 days exceed total P&L due to negative total and large positive top days). Real-fills walk-forward OOS concentration unknown.
